rules: Purpose: an encyclopedia of key psychological findings for a curious non-specialist; each entry says plainly whether the finding holds up (solid, mixed, failed) as of 2026.
Accuracy: real authors, years and journals; numbers only when sure; no invented studies, quotes or statistics; disputed accounts flagged.
Voice: plain language (short sentences, everyday words, technical terms explained in passing); original writing; British spelling; no em or en dashes; no duplicate lines.
